name: Gholdengo
description: Gholdengo, the Coin Entity Pokémon, and the evolved form of Gimmighoul. A Steel and Ghost type.
pokedex_entries: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.
It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.
